body:
Application to amend zoning for 273 and 275 Sunview St
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies before anything can be built.
Dennis Home Corp. is proposing to build new townhouse buildings at 273 and 275 Sunview Street. The plan includes 4 residential townhouse buildings, with 18 dwelling units, 3 vehicle parking spaces and 18 bicycle parking spaces.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
lift the Holding symbol to facilitate the development
reducing the minimum first storey height for the residential building to 2.7m
exemption from the cluster development regulations.
This
application is intended to proceed through delegated authority pursuant to City
of Waterloo By-law No. 2023-073, which provides the City’s Director of Planning
decision making authority for zoning amendments that are deemed to be minor in
nature. A public meeting will not be held unless the Director of Planning
refers this application to Council.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Building height: 3 storeys, 9 m
Number of units: 18
Number of bedrooms: 43 bedrooms
Unit sizes: 14 two-bedroom, 1 three-bedroom and 3 four-bedroom units
Parking
Parking: 3 surface
Bicycle parking: 18 outdoor
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared in the staff report, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.

Questions and answers will be published on this site for public viewing. If your username includes your first or last name, or your email address, these will be available for public viewing. Do not include personal or identifying information in your question; if your question is of a personal nature, consider contacting a member of the project team directly. For more information, please refer to our privacy policy.
Questions will be answered by a member of the Planning department within two business days. Some questions may require more time but they will be answered as soon as the information for the response can be collected.
